name: ai-daily-cn-static-publisher
description: Local static publishing infrastructure for Chinese AI daily reports.

scripts.build: node src/cli.js build --data-input reports-data --input reports-source --out docs
scripts.validate: npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && openspec validate add-ai-daily-static-publishing && git diff --check
scripts.publish:dry-run: node src/cli.js publish:dry-run --data-input reports-data --input reports-source --out docs
